reason: Schedule and feasibility lens. The calendar alone has about 2 days of slack: if everything works first time, a score lands around 26 Sep 21:00 to 27 Sep 03:00 UTC. The idea fails on two other counts. The DEFAULT probe variant cannot be implemented as described. And the chance of reaching any scored probe with the pre-registered gates honoured is about 0.08-0.12, far below 0.70. (1) Runtime blocker for the averaged default variant. In exp56 cell 4 the secondary runs its own 8-view D4 TTA (identity, 3 flips, 2 rotations, transpose, anti-transpose), as does the primary: 16 encoder passes per window. Averaging seed314159 with the dense model inside the 0.8 slot needs a THIRD model: +8 passes, about +50% detection time. exp51's detection plus head took ~235-265 s per video per GPU (wf_ideas_v2 r1 feasibility notes). The hidden test has ~100-130 videos (CONTEXT l.14), so the extra cost is about +1.3-2.3 h. Our x138-class hidden runs already take ~7.5 h (#31 17:09->00:39), which is right at REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = 27,000 s (DIFF.md sec.2). The guard would switch off relink, readmit, gapfill, safe divisions and linefit for the alphabetically last movies (about -0.05 per degraded movie), with a tail risk of the 12 h hard limit. Only the full-swap variant keeps the base runtime. (2) The data volume is understated. Level-0 chunks are full-XY-plane (1,1,128,2217,2170) blocks of ~400 MB (tools/dorado_crops.py). 3 blocks x 20 frames x 2 z-chunks = 120 chunks (~48 GB, or 24 GB if both z positions sit in chunk 0). Gate (b) also needs the held-out block t 380-420 as clips: 40 more chunks (~16 GB). That makes 40-64 GB, not 25-40 GB. At the logged ~70 s per chunk, streaming alone is 2-3.1 h. The 2-10 MB/s log most likely comes from the earlier Colab extraction itself (CONTEXT l.1274), so 'faster on Colab' is unfounded. (3) The writer is written blind. This container gets 403 from public.czbiohub.org (tested once) and has no data_external: no tracks.npz and no kaggle44b6_in_dorado.json, which the box exclusion, the held-out split and the parity test all need. The first real run is a debug loop in the user's attended Colab tab. The parity test also needs Kaggle 44b6 clip pixels, which are neither here nor on Colab without a competition-API fetch (the endpoint is throttled to ~0.1 MB/s, CONTEXT l.848, so fetch single frames only). (4) The idea underestimates gate cost and routes it through friend A. Gate (c) runs the full x138 pipeline on 20 6bba train videos for base, swap and averaged. No x138-on-train harness exists, and exp51's dummy run took 1,713 s for 4 videos on 2xT4, about 430 s per video wall. 60 video-runs therefore take ~7 h, not 2.5 h. The N_pred +-2% recalibration needs a new secondary-offset knob and probably a second pass (+3.5 h). 'kaggle-sasyami' is friend A's account: his availability is uncertain, and he is booked for the x138 lab cache (PROMPT_FRIEND_A.md top block). (5) Implementation glue that the idea does not list. The base train_unet_transformer.py has no --init-weights (train_patches.py adds it; the exp23 kernel reuses it). FrameWindowDataset samples uniformly over windows, so dorado would be 2,850 of 22,551 windows (13%), not 1:1, and needs a sampler patch. max_nodes padding is set by the densest window (up to ~734 points per frame versus sparse GT), so the joint transformer's pairwise edge loss needs a memory smoke test. build_probe_kernel --base x138 allows only divinsert and leafprune today (CONTEXT l.1509). (6) The Kaggle token offered in chat does not help here. This container cannot reach kaggle.com, and pushes go through the laptop agent's kaggle.json (CONTEXT l.39). For the Colab upload the user should drop their own kaggle.json into Colab, not paste the secret in chat. Cited numbers check out: probes 7, 10 and 13 were -0.016, -0.025 and -0.007 (RESULTS l.39, 42, 46); exp23 took 50 min and exp03B 27 min of training; the 0.80 blend and 0.90 retention guard are in exp56 cell 3/4; the stream rate and chunk size are in dorado_crops.py and the r2 notes. Probability chain with the gates honoured: user OK for the download and slots 0.8 x Colab extraction, debug and upload done by 26 Sep ~06:00 UTC 0.7 x parity pass 0.85 x clean fine-tune 0.9 x gate (b) 0.5 x gate (c) with N_pred within +-2% 0.55 x dummy run and runtime OK (swap variant only) 0.85, about 0.09.
